remarks: 2943 64 Street SW offers 1,699 sq ft of thoughtfully designed living space by San Rufo Homes, located on a corner lot in the Mattson community of Edmonton. This 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom detached garage home features a functional layout ideal for families and growing households. The main floor includes a bedroom and bathroom, providing flexibility for guests or family. A cozy fireplace anchors the living area, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The home also includes a side entrance, offering excellent future development potential, Upstairs, additional bedrooms are well-proportioned for comfort and privacy. Located close to parks, pathways, and everyday amenities, this upcoming home blends space, practicality, and contemporary design in a growing southwest Edmonton community. Photos representative.
